desc: This container has 10 mints, 2 for each type of breath attack.
Someone can eat one as a bonus action and immediately cast a breath weapon attack based on the mint eaten.
If the user has draconic ancestry, they can instead choose any spell based on the element eaten, at the DM's discretion.
*HEARTBURN:* after declaring your attack, immediately make a constitution save DC 17. On a failed save, you become the center of the spell.
